## Overview

Amazon ProFinder is a product-search pipeline for the Amazon Electronics category. It combines data retrieval, preprocessing, and semantic retrieval to support natural language search over Amazon product metadata and reviews.
 
---

## The Problem

Amazon product data is large and noisy, making it hard to find relevant items quickly. Traditional keyword search misses the nuance of product descriptions and reviews, while context-aware retrieval can help surface better matches.

---

## What I Built

- A semantic search pipeline using sentence-transformer embeddings and a FAISS index
- A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflow that grounds LLM answers in retrieved product context
- A hybrid search option combining BM25 keyword retrieval with dense semantic retrieval
- Notebooks and discussion artifacts for milestone analysis, model comparison, and qualitative evaluation
